venues.evidence: Ashleigh Flynn & The Riveters Sep 3, 2025; Tony Furtado (Electric Potato) Jul 2, 2025; Luke Bulla Nov 15, 2023; Alela Diane Sep 2, 2026; Rose City Band May 6, 2026; Left On Tenth, Katie Pearlman, Countryside Ride (recurring)
venues.note: POSSIBLE (my check, Oct 28). Hood River event venue running a regular Wednesday evening concert series (6-8 PM, 2026 benefit series for The Gift of Time Foundation) with Americana and roots acts. Peer trace: Ashleigh Flynn & The Riveters played Sep 3, 2025; Tony Furtado played Jul 2, 2025; fiddler Luke Bulla Nov 15, 2023. Watch out: outdoor tent with general seating (bring your own blanket or chair), so it is not a classic seated listening room; capacity, pay terms and street address not published (unknown). Pitch the Wednesday series for summer 2027. Contact events@thegriffinhouse.com (general events inbox, not a confirmed booker). Rated Possible, not Good, because shows are in an outdoor tent.
